methods.label: Determine the next palindrome
methods.explanation:
A four-digit palindrome is determined by its first two digits: the last two must be those digits in reverse order. Keeping the first two digits \(20\) gives only \(2002\). The next possible first two digits are \(21\), which give \(2112\). Any larger first two digits produce a larger year, so \(2112\) is the next palindrome.

Its digit product is
\[
2\cdot1\cdot1\cdot2=4.
\]
The answer is \(\boxed{4}\), choice \(\boxed{\text{B}}\).
